observe.surface: the interphase plugin's instruction files (core/*.md, core/pathways/*.md, core/templates/*.md, skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/*.md) as an agent reads them, and its scripts (scripts/*.py): their stdout, stderr, exit code and the spec, record and items files they write
observe.value: the exact text a pathway, phase or template states; a script's exit code and the errors and warnings it prints; the rendered spec section and items JSON
observe.observe_by: unittest reading the instruction files and running the scripts as subprocesses on temporary spec folders
observe.terminal_action: a script's run to its exit with every file it writes flushed; for instructions, the text an agent loads
observe.build_artifact: the installed plugin copy under ~/.claude/plugins/cache/interphase/interphase/<version>, whose .claude-plugin/plugin.json version must equal the checkout's; in a checkout, the files at the commit
observe.twin: the four pathway playbooks and their spec templates restate shared rules from core/phases.md and core/questioning.md; README.md restates the pathways
observe.dependent: every interphase run in any repository; the pipeline:run skill, which invokes the pathway skills; mitosis, which reads the items file
observe.receipt: a unittest in tests/ named for the behaviour, red before the change and green after, run as python3 -m unittest tests.<module>.<Class>.<method>
observe.compat_boundary: a record or items file written by one release and read by another; an installed plugin copy that stays on its version until the plugin version changes

reach.access: the repository checkout; Python 3.9 or later; no credentials
reach.shortcut: every script runs locally on temporary folders
reach.fixtures: tests build temporary spec folders and records
special_surfaces: an agent's reading of the instruction files, observed only by running an interphase session
